units.source_text: 到了四月里，新皇妃分娩，生下一位皇女。

en.t: In the fourth month, the new imperial consort gave birth to an imperial princess.

units.source_text: 冷泉院并不准备盛大庆祝。

en.t: Reizei-in did not plan any grand celebration.

units.source_text: 但群臣察知冷泉院心中欢乐，都来道喜。

en.t: But the courtiers sensed the joy in Reizei-in's heart and all came to offer congratulations.

units.source_text: 自夕雾右大臣开始，致送产汤贺礼者甚多。

en.t: Beginning with Yugiri, the Right Minister, many people sent gifts for the first-bath celebration.

units.source_text: 玉鬘尚侍非常疼爱这新生的外孙女，一直抱在怀里。

en.t: Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, dearly loved this newborn granddaughter and kept holding her in her arms.

units.source_text: 但冷泉院不断遣使前来催促，盼望早日看到这小皇女。

en.t: But Reizei-in kept sending messengers to hurry them, longing to see the little princess as soon as possible.

units.source_text: 于是小皇女就在诞生五十日那天回宫中去。

en.t: So the little princess returned to the palace on the fiftieth day after her birth.

units.source_text: 冷泉院只有弘徽殿女御所生一位皇女，

en.t: Reizei-in had only one other princess, born to the Kokiden Consort,

units.source_text: 如今看见这小皇女生得十分美丽，便异常疼爱她，从此更经常在新皇妃房中住宿了。

en.t: and now, seeing how very beautiful this little princess was, he loved her extraordinarily and thereafter stayed even more often in the new consort's rooms.

units.source_text: 弘徽殿女御身边的侍女就抱不平，说道：

en.t: The ladies serving the Kokiden Consort felt indignant and said,

units.source_text: “这件事实在是不应该做的。”

en.t: This is truly something he ought not to do.

units.source_text: 两女主人本人并不轻率地斗气，

en.t: The two ladies themselves did not rashly compete out of spite,

units.source_text: 但两方侍女之间，常常发生无谓的冲突。

en.t: but pointless clashes often broke out between the attendants on the two sides.

units.source_text: 由此看来，那左近中将毕竟是长兄，他的话果然应验了。

en.t: Seen in this light, that Sakon no Chujo was indeed the elder brother, and his words had come true after all.

units.source_text: 玉鬘尚侍想道：

en.t: Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, thought,

units.source_text: “只管这样吵吵闹闹，不知将来结果如何。

en.t: If this noisy quarrelling simply goes on, who knows how it will turn out in the future.

units.source_text: 我的女儿会不会遭受虐待，被世人耻笑呢？

en.t: Will my daughter be mistreated and made a laughingstock before the world?

units.source_text: 上皇对她的宠爱固然不浅，

en.t: The Retired Emperor's affection for her is certainly not slight,

units.source_text: 然而秋好皇后和弘徽殿女御都是长年侍奉左右的人，

en.t: yet Empress Akikonomu and the Kokiden Consort have both served at his side for many years,

units.source_text: 深恐她们侧目而视，不能相容，那时我的女儿要吃苦了。”

en.t: and I deeply fear that if they look at her coldly and cannot accept her, my daughter will suffer then.

units.source_text: 有人告诉她说：

en.t: Someone told her,

units.source_text: “今上实在很不高兴，屡次向人发牢骚呢。”

en.t: The reigning Emperor is truly displeased and has complained to people many times.

units.source_text: 玉鬘尚侍想道：

en.t: Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, thought,

units.source_text: “我不妨把次女送入宫中。

en.t: Perhaps I should send my second daughter into the palace.

units.source_text: 进后宫颇多麻烦，就让她当个司理公务的女官吧。”

en.t: Entering the inner court would bring many complications, so I will have her serve as a court lady handling official duties.

units.source_text: 便向朝廷申请，欲将自己的尚侍职位让与二女公子。

en.t: She then petitioned the court, wishing to pass her own post as Naishi no Kami to her second daughter.

units.source_text: 尚侍是朝廷所重视的官职，

en.t: The office of Naishi no Kami was a position highly valued by the court,

units.source_text: 故玉鬘多年前决心辞职，终于未得准许。

en.t: so when Tamakazura had resolved to resign many years earlier, permission had never finally been granted.

units.source_text: 但此次朝廷顾念已故髭黑太政大臣遗志，

en.t: This time, however, the court considered the wishes of the late Grand Minister Higekuro,

units.source_text: 援用很久以前由母让位于女的古例，居然准许了她。

en.t: and, citing an ancient precedent in which a mother had yielded her post to her daughter, unexpectedly granted her request.

units.source_text: 外人都以为二女公子命里注定要当尚侍，

en.t: People outside all thought that the second daughter must have been destined to become Naishi no Kami,

units.source_text: 因此玉鬘前年辞职不获准许也。

en.t: and that this was why Tamakazura had not been allowed to resign the year before.
